summary: Independent review of Jinshu 053 (Sima Yu) against the Chinese units only. Core conversions hold at year precision under the usual pre-1582 Julian tables, which here match proleptic Gregorian for the Western year: 惠帝即位 and the tutor list are AD 290; 元康元年 is AD 291; 九年六月 is AD 299 as an omen date; 九年十二月 through 永康元年六月 are AD 300 (month 12 of Yuankang 9 already falls in January–February 300); 永甯/永寧元年 is AD 301; 太安元年三月 and 太安初 are the 壬戌 civil year AD 302. Ages 五歲 and 二十三 sui are preserved without a birth year. Retrospective citations (Yang, Shen Sheng, Xiao Ji, Chu Jian, Crown Prince Li) are kept off life dates. Defects: Yu's hints omit AD 290 and misuse the 299 omen; Zang has a living AD 302 attestation for a posthumous 諡; Wei Guan, Sima Tai and Hua Gao inherited their sons' 291 year; Princess Changguang was dated from a forged speech. The chapter's 六月己卯 burial day conflicts with the annals' 六月壬寅 and with the Yongkang 1 month-6 stem list; the Western year remains 300.

references.title: 元康 (西晋)
references.quote: 元康十年（300年）正月一日，改元為永康元年。
references.reason: Confirms Yuankang ends when Yongkang 1 opens on New Year's Day of AD 300, so 九年十二月 is the month immediately before that New Year.

references.title: 元康 (西晋) lunar-Western table
references.reason: Places Yuankang 9 in the 己未 civil year conventionally labeled AD 299; the same table puts month 6 at mid-July 299 and month 12 at 8 January 300.

references.title: 永康 (西晋)
references.reason: Yongkang 1 is the 庚申 year AD 300; month 1 begins 7 February and month 6 begins 3 July, so the funeral 六月 and the 三月 killing stay in AD 300.

references.title: 晉書/卷004 惠帝紀
references.quote: 秋八月壬午，立广陵王遹为皇太子，以中书监何劭为太子太师，吏部尚书王戎为太子太傅，卫将军杨济为太子太保。
references.reason: Annals date Yu's establishment as crown prince, and the three grand tutors, to Yongxi 1 month 8, supporting AD 290 as Yu's own appointment year omitted from the hints.

references.title: 晉書/卷004 惠帝紀 burial day
references.quote: 六月壬寅，葬愍怀太子于显平陵。
references.reason: Competing day for the Xianping burial: the annals write 六月壬寅 against this chapter's 六月己卯. Both sit in Yongkang 1 month 6 / AD 300; 己卯 is not a day of that month.

references.title: 晉書/卷004 惠帝紀 Shang death
references.quote: 三月癸卯，赦司、冀、兖、豫四州。皇太孙尚薨。
references.reason: The annals keep 皇太孫尚薨 under 太安元年三月癸卯 of the 壬戌 civil year, so AD 302 is the chapter's Western year even though the era name was proclaimed in month 12.

references.title: 太安 (西晋)
references.quote: 太安（或作大安； 302年十二月—303年）是西晋皇帝晋惠帝司马衷的第六个年号
references.reason: Records that the Tai'an name began in the twelfth month of AD 302. Conventional 太安元年 / 太安初 still labels the 壬戌 civil year 302, which is how this chapter and the annals date the March death.
